fields: Original market history fields are retained, including odds, share percentages, GBP amounts, volume and timestamps; source row IDs and fingerprints are retained when exposed by the source table.
source: Supabase READ-ONLY; canonical roster provenance and table details are documented below.
source_archive_notes: Source manifest declares 368 full-day fixtures and an incomplete source collection. The current public.fixtures table has 363 rows with a different roster; the canonical 368-fixture roster from the existing full-day concentrated archive is used. Historical rows are queried by fixture_uid or unique match_id_hash. research_archive.results has results for 366/368. Public history lacks source_fingerprint and source IDs may be null.
missing_policy: MISSING explicit; latest observation at or before target only; exact fixture_uid preferred and match_id_hash fallback used only when unique; stable source id order for equal times; no interpolation or future substitution.
